name.en: Karsh International Scholars Program — Duke University (Fall 2027)
name.ka: Karsh-ის საერთაშორისო სტიპენდიანტთა პროგრამა — Duke University (2027 შემოდგომა)
name.ar: برنامج كارش للطلاب الدوليين — جامعة ديوك (خريف 2027)

deadline_note: Duke Regular Decision deadline is 4 Jan 2027 (Early Decision 2 Nov 2026); CSS Profile for RD due 1 Feb 2027. There is no separate Karsh application: you must request financial aid in your first-year application.

summary.en: Duke's flagship scholarship for international undergraduates pays tuition, room, board and fees, plus any extra demonstrated need, and funds three summers of research or internships. You are considered automatically when you apply to Duke and request financial aid.
summary.ka: Duke-ის მთავარი სტიპენდია საერთაშორისო ბაკალავრებისთვის ფარავს სწავლას, საცხოვრებელს, კვებასა და მოსაკრებლებს, ასევე დამატებით დადასტურებულ საჭიროებას, და აფინანსებს სამ ზაფხულს კვლევისთვის ან სტაჟირებისთვის. განიხილებით ავტომატურად, თუ Duke-ზე განაცხადისას ფინანსურ დახმარებას მოითხოვთ.
summary.ar: منحة ديوك الرئيسية لطلاب البكالوريوس الدوليين تغطي الرسوم الدراسية والسكن والطعام والرسوم الإلزامية وأي حاجة مالية إضافية، وتموّل ثلاثة صيفيات للبحث أو التدريب. تُرشَّح تلقائيًا عند التقدم إلى ديوك وطلب المساعدة المالية.

about.en:
The Karsh International Scholars Program, funded by Bruce and Martha Karsh, is Duke University's top award for students who are not US citizens. Each year it selects high-achieving international first-years who also have financial need, and it currently has scholars from more than 20 countries, from Botswana and Egypt to Pakistan and Vietnam.

The scholarship covers tuition, room and board, mandatory fees and any demonstrated need beyond those costs, so a Karsh Scholar pays nothing for the four-year degree at one of the top private universities in the US. Scholars also receive funding for three summers of research, unpaid internships or similar experiences, and join an enrichment programme run by Duke's Office of University Scholars and Fellows.

There is no separate application and no nominations: you apply to Duke as a first-year (Early Decision by 2 Nov 2026 or Regular Decision by 4 Jan 2027) and request need-based aid in that same application. International students who do not request aid at the point of admission cannot get Duke funding later, so tick the box.

en: Full cost of attendance plus any extra demonstrated need
Funding for three summers of research or internships
No separate application: apply to Duke and request aid

eligibility.en: Citizens of any country other than the US (dual US citizens are not eligible) applying as first-year undergraduates who do not already hold a bachelor's degree. Applicants must demonstrate financial need and request aid in their first-year application. Strong academics are expected; English proficiency is required for non-native speakers.

en: Apply to Duke via the Common App or QuestBridge by 4 Jan 2027 (Regular Decision) or 2 Nov 2026 (Early Decision)
Indicate in the application that you are applying for need-based financial aid
Submit the CSS Profile and Duke's financial aid documents (RD: by 1 Feb 2027)
Admitted applicants with need are reviewed for the Karsh Scholarship; no separate essay is required

costs.en: Tuition, room and board, mandatory fees and demonstrated need above those costs, for four years, plus three summers of funded experiences. Duke's application fee (about US$85) applies unless waived.

score_reason: Full ride at a top-10 US university with no extra application; RD deadline 4 Jan 2027.

name.en: Emory University Scholar Programs — Woodruff Scholars (Fall 2027)
name.ka: Emory University-ის სტიპენდიანტთა პროგრამები — Woodruff Scholars (2027 შემოდგომა)
name.ar: برامج منح جامعة إيموري — منحة وودرف (خريف 2027)

deadline_note: Official: answer 'Yes' to the Scholar Programs question and apply by 15 Nov 2026 (ED II and RD applicants) or 1 Nov 2026 (ED I). Finalists notified by end of February 2027.

summary.en: Emory's merit programme picks 175–200 finalists from about 10,000 applicants and awards scholarships from partial up to full cost of attendance. International applicants are eligible regardless of citizenship.
summary.ka: Emory-ის დამსახურებაზე დაფუძნებული პროგრამა დაახლოებით 10 000 აპლიკანტიდან 175–200 ფინალისტს არჩევს და ანიჭებს სტიპენდიას ნაწილობრივიდან სრულ ხარჯებამდე. საერთაშორისო აპლიკანტებს მონაწილეობა მოქალაქეობის მიუხედავად შეუძლიათ.
summary.ar: يختار برنامج المنح الدراسية في إيموري 175–200 متأهلًا من نحو 10,000 متقدم ويمنح منحًا تتراوح بين الجزئية والتغطية الكاملة لتكاليف الدراسة. يحق للمتقدمين الدوليين التقدم بغض النظر عن الجنسية.

about.en:
The Emory University Scholar Programs are Emory's merit scholarships for first-year students, led by the Robert W. Woodruff Scholarship, which at its top level covers full tuition, fees, housing and meals. Scholars study either at Emory College in Atlanta or at Oxford College (a two-year liberal arts campus that feeds into Emory College), and join a community with early registration, special programming and faculty mentorship.

About 10,000 students opt in each year and 175–200 become finalists. Awards range from partial to full scholarships and are renewable for eight semesters. Emory states clearly that first-year, home-schooled and international applicants can apply regardless of citizenship. Finalists are interviewed in spring (an on-campus visit for US-based finalists).

The key point is timing: you must submit your full Emory application by 15 November 2026 (1 November for Early Decision I) even if you apply Regular Decision, and answer 'Yes' to the Scholar Programs question. Students not chosen are still considered for admission and for other merit awards.

en: Awards from partial up to full tuition, fees, housing and meals
Open to international applicants regardless of citizenship
Just tick 'Yes' on the application: no separate form

eligibility.en: First-year applicants of any citizenship, including international and home-schooled students. Selection is based on academic excellence, leadership and character as shown in the application. English proficiency (TOEFL/IELTS/Duolingo) is recommended if English is not your first language.

en: Create a Common App account and add Emory University
Answer 'Yes' to the question about the Emory University Scholar Programs
Submit the complete application by 15 Nov 2026 (ED II/RD) or 1 Nov 2026 (ED I)
If named a finalist (late February), take part in the spring finalist interviews
Apply separately for need-based aid if you also need it

costs.en: From partial scholarships up to full tuition, fees, housing and meals for eight semesters (top Woodruff level). Merit is applied before any need-based aid.

score_reason: Internationals eligible for full-ride merit; early mid-November deadline.

name.en: Vanderbilt Signature Merit Scholarships — Cornelius Vanderbilt & Ingram (Fall 2027)
name.ka: Vanderbilt-ის ხელმოწერის სტიპენდიები — Cornelius Vanderbilt და Ingram (2027 შემოდგომა)
name.ar: منح فاندربيلت المميزة — كورنيليوس فاندربيلت وإنغرام (خريف 2027)

deadline_note: Official scholarship site: Ingram and Cornelius Vanderbilt applications must be submitted via MyAppVU by 1 Dec 2026; recipients notified end of March 2027.

summary.en: More than 225 first-years each year receive Vanderbilt's full-tuition signature scholarships, plus a summer stipend for study abroad, research or service. Vanderbilt confirms international applicants are eligible for all its merit scholarships.
summary.ka: ყოველწლიურად 225-ზე მეტი პირველკურსელი იღებს Vanderbilt-ის სრული სწავლის საფასურის სტიპენდიას და ზაფხულის სტიპენდიას საზღვარგარეთ სწავლის, კვლევის ან მოხალისეობისთვის. Vanderbilt ადასტურებს, რომ საერთაშორისო აპლიკანტები ყველა სტიპენდიაზე უფლებამოსილნი არიან.
summary.ar: يحصل أكثر من 225 طالبًا جديدًا سنويًا على منح فاندربيلت المميزة التي تغطي الرسوم الدراسية كاملة، إضافة إلى مخصص صيفي للدراسة في الخارج أو البحث أو الخدمة. تؤكد فاندربيلت أن المتقدمين الدوليين مؤهلون لجميع منحها.

about.en:
Vanderbilt University in Nashville awards its signature merit scholarships to roughly the top 1% of first-year applicants. The Cornelius Vanderbilt Scholarship gives full tuition plus a one-time summer stipend for an immersive experience after the sophomore or junior year; the Ingram Scholars Program adds a focus on community service and social impact. Applying for the Cornelius Vanderbilt Scholarship also puts you in the pool for additional merit awards (Carell Family, Curb Leadership, Fred Russell–Grantland Rice).

Vanderbilt's scholarship FAQ states that international applicants are eligible to receive any of its merit scholarships, and test scores are optional for fall 2027 scholarship consideration. Financial need is not a factor, but Vanderbilt meets 100% of demonstrated need for admitted students who apply for aid, so need-based aid can top up the tuition award.

After you submit the Common App, Coalition or QuestBridge application, you receive a MyAppVU account where you upload the scholarship essays. Everything must be submitted by 1 December 2026, whichever admission round you choose. Awards renew yearly with at least a 3.0 GPA.

en: Full tuition for four years plus a summer stipend
International applicants eligible for all merit scholarships
Test-optional for fall 2027 scholarship review

eligibility.en: First-year applicants of any nationality applying to Vanderbilt for fall 2027. Selection is based on academic achievement, intellectual promise, leadership and contribution outside the classroom. Blair School of Music applicants are also judged on auditions.

en: Submit the Common App, Coalition or QuestBridge application to Vanderbilt
Activate your MyAppVU account (emailed 2–3 days after you apply)
Under the Scholarship tab, choose the Cornelius Vanderbilt and/or Ingram programme and upload your essays by 1 Dec 2026
Also apply for need-based aid (CSS Profile) if you need help beyond tuition
Recipients are notified at the end of March 2027

costs.en: Full tuition for eight semesters plus a one-time summer stipend; housing, meals and travel are not covered by the merit award (need-based aid can cover them).

score_reason: Over 225 full-tuition awards open to internationals; 1 Dec deadline.

name.en: Johnson Scholarship — Washington and Lee University (Fall 2027)
name.ka: Johnson Scholarship — Washington and Lee University (2027 შემოდგომა)
name.ar: منحة جونسون — جامعة واشنطن ولي (خريف 2027)

deadline_note: W&L: Johnson Scholarship application (Common App + Johnson supplement and English proficiency documents) due 1 Dec 2026 for ED I, ED II and RD alike; extra supporting materials by 15 Dec 2026.

summary.en: Up to 44 first-years a year win this full ride at a top US liberal arts university: tuition, fees, housing and food plus $10,000 for summer experiences. International applicants apply through the same Johnson supplement.
summary.ka: ყოველწლიურად 44-მდე პირველკურსელი იღებს ამ სრულ სტიპენდიას აშშ-ის წამყვან ლიბერალური ხელოვნების უნივერსიტეტში: სწავლა, მოსაკრებლები, საცხოვრებელი და კვება, პლუს 10 000 დოლარი ზაფხულის პროგრამებისთვის. საერთაშორისო აპლიკანტები იმავე Johnson-ის დანართით აკეთებენ განაცხადს.
summary.ar: يفوز ما يصل إلى 44 طالبًا جديدًا سنويًا بهذه المنحة الكاملة في جامعة أمريكية رائدة للفنون الحرة: الرسوم الدراسية والرسوم والسكن والطعام، إضافة إلى 10,000 دولار لتجارب صيفية. يتقدم الطلاب الدوليون عبر ملحق جونسون نفسه.

about.en:
The Johnson Scholarship at Washington and Lee University (W&L), a highly ranked liberal arts university in Lexington, Virginia, is one of the most generous merit awards in the US. It covers tuition and fees, housing and food (worth over US$89,000 a year) plus US$10,000 in summer enhancement funds for internships, research or travel. Students with additional need can receive more.

Up to 44 incoming students (about 10% of the class) become Johnson Scholars each year. The Johnson application also serves as the application for all other W&L merit scholarships. W&L's international admissions page lists the Johnson deadline alongside the regular international requirements, and international applicants must send English proficiency documents by the same 1 December date.

Finalists are invited to an on-campus selection weekend (costs paid by W&L) where they stay with a current scholar, attend classes and interview. Winners are notified by mid-March 2027.

en: Tuition, fees, housing and food plus US$10,000 for summers
Up to 44 awards a year (~10% of the class)
Expenses-paid finalist weekend

eligibility.en: First-year applicants to W&L, including international students. You must submit the Common Application and the Johnson Scholarship supplement (a second personal essay) by 1 Dec 2026; non-native English speakers must send English proficiency documents by the same date.

en: Submit the Common App to Washington and Lee (ED I, ED II or RD)
Complete the Johnson Scholarship supplement with its extra essay by 1 Dec 2026
International applicants: send English proficiency results by 1 Dec 2026
Send any additional supporting materials by 15 Dec 2026
If selected as a finalist, attend the selection weekend; decisions by mid-March

costs.en: Full tuition and fees, housing and food (over US$89,000 a year) plus US$10,000 summer enhancement funding, for four years.

score_reason: True full ride open to internationals; 1 Dec deadline.

name.en: Tulane Global Scholarships for International Students (Fall 2027)
name.ka: Tulane-ის გლობალური სტიპენდიები საერთაშორისო სტუდენტებისთვის (2027 შემოდგომა)
name.ar: منح تولين العالمية للطلاب الدوليين (خريف 2027)

deadline_note: Tulane international aid page: apply Early Action by 10 Nov (or Early Decision by 1 Nov) to be competitive for Global Scholarships; video interviews by 31 Mar.

summary.en: Tulane's Global Scholarships are merit awards for international first-years that can cover full tuition and fees or even the full cost of attendance. The admission committee nominates candidates from the Common App and CSS Profile.
summary.ka: Tulane-ის გლობალური სტიპენდიები საერთაშორისო პირველკურსელებისთვის განკუთვნილი დამსახურების ჯილდოებია, რომლებიც შეიძლება ფარავდეს სრულ სწავლასა და მოსაკრებლებს ან სრულ ხარჯებსაც კი. კანდიდატებს მიმღები კომისია Common App-ისა და CSS Profile-ის მიხედვით ასახელებს.
summary.ar: منح تولين العالمية جوائز جدارة للطلاب الدوليين الجدد قد تغطي الرسوم الدراسية والرسوم كاملة أو حتى التكلفة الكاملة للدراسة. ترشّح لجنة القبول المرشحين بناءً على Common App وCSS Profile.

about.en:
Tulane University in New Orleans reserves its Global Scholarships for international first-year students. These merit awards may cover full tuition and fees or even the full cost of attendance, and renew for four years (five for the architecture programme). Tulane also offers partial merit awards open to all applicants and up to US$30,000 of need-based aid for international students.

There is no separate essay: the international admission committee nominates candidates based on the Common Application and the CSS Profile. Applicants in roughly the top 20% academically are most competitive, and submitting test scores is preferred though not required. Some candidates are invited to a video interview by 31 March.

To be competitive you must apply early: Early Action by 10 November 2026 or Early Decision by 1 November 2026, plus the CSS Profile and Tulane's Declaration & Certification of Finances.

en: Can cover full tuition and fees or full cost of attendance
Reserved for international first-years
No separate scholarship essay: nomination from your application

eligibility.en: Non-US citizens applying as first-year students. Strong academic record (top 20% of applicants most competitive); test scores preferred but optional. Must apply Early Action or Early Decision and submit the CSS Profile.

en: Submit the Common App to Tulane by 10 Nov 2026 (Early Action) or 1 Nov (ED)
Complete the CSS Profile
Submit Tulane's Declaration & Certification of Finances
Respond if invited to a video interview (by 31 March)

costs.en: Up to full tuition and fees, and in some cases full cost of attendance, renewable for four years.

score_reason: International-only full-tuition merit; early 10 Nov deadline.

name.en: Boston University Presidential Scholarship (Fall 2027)
name.ka: Boston University-ის საპრეზიდენტო სტიპენდია (2027 შემოდგომა)
name.ar: منحة الرئيس في جامعة بوسطن (خريف 2027)

deadline_note: BU first-year merit page: complete the admission application by 1 Dec 2026 to be considered; listed for international students. Half tuition from fall 2026 onward.

summary.en: Boston University's Presidential Scholarship gives half tuition each year to high-achieving first-years from around the world, including international students. You only need to complete the BU application by 1 December.
summary.ka: Boston University-ის საპრეზიდენტო სტიპენდია მსოფლიოს მაღალი მიღწევების მქონე პირველკურსელებს, მათ შორის საერთაშორისო სტუდენტებს, ყოველწლიურად სწავლის საფასურის ნახევარს უფარავს. საკმარისია BU-ზე განაცხადის 1 დეკემბრამდე შევსება.
summary.ar: تمنح منحة الرئيس في جامعة بوسطن نصف الرسوم الدراسية سنويًا للطلاب الجدد المتفوقين من أنحاء العالم، ومنهم الطلاب الدوليون. يكفي إكمال طلب الالتحاق بالجامعة قبل 1 ديسمبر.

about.en:
Boston University, a large private research university in the heart of Boston, awards the Presidential Scholarship to first-year students from around the globe who show exceptional academic achievement as well as talent, initiative, creativity and impact in their school or community. From students entering in fall 2026, the award is worth half tuition each year and renews for four years.

BU's merit page lists the Presidential Scholarship under both 'US citizens and permanent residents' and 'International students'. There is no separate application: the only requirement is to complete your BU admission application by 1 December 2026. International students should note that BU's need-based aid for non-US citizens is very limited, so plan to cover the remaining half of tuition plus living costs.

en: Half tuition every year for four years
Open to international students
Only requirement: apply to BU by 1 December

eligibility.en: First-year applicants from any country with exceptional academic records, considered automatically if the BU application is complete by 1 Dec 2026.

en: Apply to Boston University through the Common App
Make sure your application is complete by 1 Dec 2026
No extra scholarship form is needed; recipients are told with their admission decision

costs.en: Half tuition per year (renewable); housing, meals and other costs are not covered.

score_reason: Partial (half tuition) but automatic and open to internationals.

name.en: Richmond Scholars Program — University of Richmond (Fall 2027)
name.ka: Richmond Scholars პროგრამა — University of Richmond (2027 შემოდგომა)
name.ar: برنامج ريتشموند للمتفوقين — جامعة ريتشموند (خريف 2027)

deadline_note: University of Richmond: all first-year applicants with a complete admission application by 1 Dec 2026 are considered regardless of citizenship.

summary.en: Up to 25 incoming students a year receive full tuition, housing and food at the University of Richmond, a top US liberal arts university. All first-year applicants, including internationals, are considered if they apply by 1 December.
summary.ka: ყოველწლიურად 25-მდე ახალი სტუდენტი იღებს სრულ სწავლას, საცხოვრებელსა და კვებას University of Richmond-ში, აშშ-ის ერთ-ერთ წამყვან ლიბერალური ხელოვნების უნივერსიტეტში. ყველა პირველკურსელი აპლიკანტი, მათ შორის საერთაშორისო, განიხილება, თუ 1 დეკემბრამდე წარადგენს განაცხადს.
summary.ar: يحصل ما يصل إلى 25 طالبًا جديدًا سنويًا على الرسوم الدراسية والسكن والطعام كاملة في جامعة ريتشموند، إحدى أبرز جامعات الفنون الحرة الأمريكية. يُنظر في جميع المتقدمين الجدد، ومنهم الدوليون، إذا قدّموا قبل 1 ديسمبر.

about.en:
The Richmond Scholars Program is the University of Richmond's most prestigious merit award. It covers full tuition, housing and food for up to eight semesters (including study abroad) and comes with a community of scholars, special programming and funding opportunities. Up to 25 incoming students are selected each year.

The university's financial aid office states that all first-year applicants are considered for the Richmond Scholars Program regardless of citizenship status, as long as they submit a complete admission application by 1 December. No separate scholarship application is needed. Richmond also meets 100% of demonstrated need for admitted students who apply for need-based aid; international applicants not applying for aid complete an International Financial Certification.

Semi-finalists and finalists are invited to further selection steps in early spring.

en: Full tuition, housing and food for eight semesters
Open regardless of citizenship
No separate application: complete your file by 1 December

eligibility.en: All first-year applicants, US and international, with a complete admission application by 1 Dec 2026. Transfer students are not eligible.

en: Submit the Common App to the University of Richmond by 1 Dec 2026
Make sure transcripts, recommendations and (if needed) English test scores arrive by the deadline
Apply for need-based aid or submit the International Financial Certification
Take part in finalist activities if invited

costs.en: Full tuition, housing and food, renewable for up to eight consecutive semesters.

score_reason: Full ride considered automatically for internationals; 1 Dec deadline.

name.en: Soka Opportunity Plan & International Need-Based Aid — Soka University of America (2027–28)
name.ka: Soka Opportunity Plan და საერთაშორისო საჭიროებაზე დაფუძნებული დახმარება — Soka University of America (2027–28)
name.ar: خطة سوكا للفرص والمساعدات المالية للطلاب الدوليين — جامعة سوكا الأمريكية (2027–28)

deadline_note: Soka admission: Early Action 1 Nov 2026, Regular Admission 15 Jan 2027; international financial aid application opens ~1 Nov, priority 15 Feb, final 2 Mar 2027.

summary.en: From 2027–28, Soka guarantees 100% tuition coverage for students whose families earn US$200,000 or less, and every admitted student gets a merit scholarship. International students are eligible for need-based aid.
summary.ka: 2027–28 წლიდან Soka უზრუნველყოფს სწავლის საფასურის 100%-ით დაფარვას სტუდენტებისთვის, რომელთა ოჯახის შემოსავალი 200 000 დოლარს არ აღემატება, ხოლო ყველა ჩარიცხული სტუდენტი იღებს დამსახურების სტიპენდიას. საერთაშორისო სტუდენტებს საჭიროებაზე დაფუძნებული დახმარების მიღება შეუძლიათ.
summary.ar: اعتبارًا من 2027–28 تضمن سوكا تغطية 100% من الرسوم الدراسية للطلاب الذين يقل دخل أسرهم عن 200,000 دولار أو يساويه، ويحصل كل طالب مقبول على منحة جدارة. الطلاب الدوليون مؤهلون للمساعدات القائمة على الحاجة.

about.en:
Soka University of America is a small liberal arts college in Southern California with a highly international student body and a required study-abroad semester. Through the updated Soka Opportunity Plan, from the 2027–2028 academic year every eligible family with total income of US$200,000 or less gets 100% tuition covered; incomes of US$200,001–250,000 get 50% and US$250,001–300,000 get 25%.

Every admitted undergraduate automatically receives a merit scholarship regardless of income, which counts towards the guarantee. International students are eligible for need-based aid through the Soka International Student Financial Aid Application, and students with the highest need can receive grants beyond tuition.

Apply for admission by 1 November 2026 (Early Action) or 15 January 2027 (Regular). The international aid application is expected to open on 1 November; apply by 15 February 2027 for an aid offer in March (final deadline 2 March).

en: 100% tuition for family income ≤ US$200,000 (2027–28)
Automatic merit scholarship for every admitted student
International students eligible for need-based aid

eligibility.en: First-year applicants of any nationality. Need-based aid requires the Soka International Student Financial Aid Application with supporting documents. Soka prefers TOEFL iBT 100 / Duolingo 130 (new TOEFL scale 5) or at least TOEFL 80 / Duolingo 115 for non-native speakers.

en: Apply via the Common App or Soka Online Application by 15 Jan 2027 (or EA by 1 Nov 2026)
Complete the Soka International Student Financial Aid Application (opens ~1 Nov)
Submit financial documents by the 15 Feb 2027 priority deadline (final 2 Mar)
Receive your aid offer in the second week of March

costs.en: Tuition guarantee: 100% (income ≤ US$200k), 50% (US$200–250k) or 25% (US$250–300k). Housing, meals and travel are covered only if need-based grants exceed tuition.

score_reason: Tuition-free for most families incl. internationals; Jan deadline.

name.en: Berea College Full Scholarship for International Students (Fall 2027)
name.ka: Berea College-ის სრული სტიპენდია საერთაშორისო სტუდენტებისთვის (2027 შემოდგომა)
name.ar: منحة كلية بيريا الكاملة للطلاب الدوليين (خريف 2027)

deadline_note: Berea international FAQ: all application components due 30 Nov for the following fall intake (international students enter only in fall); no extensions; decisions by 31 Mar.

summary.en: Every admitted international student at Berea College receives aid covering 100% of tuition, housing, food and fees. Berea admits about 40 or fewer new international students a year and also offers paid campus work.
summary.ka: Berea College-ში ჩარიცხული ყველა საერთაშორისო სტუდენტი იღებს დახმარებას, რომელიც ფარავს სწავლის, საცხოვრებლის, კვებისა და მოსაკრებლების 100%-ს. Berea წელიწადში დაახლოებით 40 ან ნაკლებ ახალ საერთაშორისო სტუდენტს იღებს და ანაზღაურებად სამუშაოსაც სთავაზობს კამპუსზე.
summary.ar: يحصل كل طالب دولي مقبول في كلية بيريا على مساعدات تغطي 100% من الرسوم الدراسية والسكن والطعام والرسوم. تقبل بيريا نحو 40 طالبًا دوليًا جديدًا أو أقل سنويًا وتوفر عملًا مدفوعًا داخل الحرم.

about.en:
Berea College in Kentucky is a liberal arts college that charges no tuition to any student and runs a mandatory Labor Program in which every student works on campus for pay. For international students, admission comes with financial aid and scholarships covering 100% of tuition, housing, food and fees, making it one of the very few fully funded US undergraduate options open to all nationalities.

Berea admits about 40 or fewer new international students each year (around 120 are enrolled, from more than 70 countries), so competition is intense and the personal essay carries particular weight. Admitted students pay a US$2,200 deposit to confirm their place (an adjustment can be requested). New international students start only in the fall term.

The deadline is strict: all components must be submitted by 30 November, with no extensions. Applicants who cannot finish by then are told to apply for the following year.

en: 100% of tuition, housing, food and fees for admitted internationals
Paid on-campus work for personal expenses
About 40 places a year for international students

eligibility.en: International applicants who meet their own country's university entrance requirements and do not already hold a bachelor's degree. Every applicant must submit one test score: TOEFL iBT 68, IELTS 6.0 (no band below 5), Duolingo 95, SAT 980 or ACT 19 (nursing needs TOEFL 83).

en: Create an account on Berea's online application portal
Submit the application, essay, transcripts, recommendations and test score by 30 Nov 2026
Wait for the decision by 31 March 2027
If admitted, pay the US$2,200 enrolment deposit and complete visa forms

costs.en: Tuition, housing, food and fees fully covered; students pay a US$2,200 deposit and their own personal expenses (helped by campus work earnings).

score_reason: Guaranteed full funding for every admitted international; deadline 30 Nov.

org: Davis United World College Scholars Program

name.en: Davis UWC Scholars Program (for UWC graduates, 2027 entry)
name.ka: Davis UWC Scholars პროგრამა (UWC-ის კურსდამთავრებულებისთვის, 2027)
name.ar: برنامج ديفيس لخريجي كليات العالم المتحد (UWC) — دخول 2027

deadline_note: No separate Davis application or deadline: graduates of UWC schools apply to Davis partner colleges by each college's own deadline (mostly 1–15 Jan 2027 for regular decision).

summary.en: The Davis UWC Scholars Program funds need-based aid for graduates of the 18 UWC schools at 106 US partner colleges and universities in 35 states. Partner colleges combine Davis grants with their own aid to meet admitted scholars' need.
summary.ka: Davis UWC Scholars პროგრამა აფინანსებს საჭიროებაზე დაფუძნებულ დახმარებას 18 UWC სკოლის კურსდამთავრებულებისთვის აშშ-ის 35 შტატის 106 პარტნიორ კოლეჯსა და უნივერსიტეტში. პარტნიორები Davis-ის გრანტებს საკუთარ დახმარებას უმატებენ ჩარიცხული სტიპენდიანტების საჭიროების დასაფარად.
summary.ar: يموّل برنامج ديفيس منحًا قائمة على الحاجة لخريجي مدارس UWC الثماني عشرة في 106 كليات وجامعات أمريكية شريكة في 35 ولاية. تجمع الكليات الشريكة منح ديفيس مع مساعداتها الخاصة لتغطية حاجة الطلاب المقبولين.

about.en:
Founded by philanthropist Shelby M.C. Davis, the Davis United World College Scholars Program has supported more than 4,600 scholars. It gives grants to 106 partner colleges (2026–27) across 35 US states and universities, which use them to provide need-based financial aid to graduates of the 18 United World College (UWC) schools.

It is relevant to you if you are at, or will graduate from, a UWC school (including students who entered through a UWC national committee). You apply to Davis partner colleges in the normal way, and if admitted on your own merit the college packages Davis funds with its own aid to meet your demonstrated need, which often means a full ride. Partners range from research universities to small liberal arts colleges; the current 2026–27 list is published on the Davis website.

There is no separate Davis application: deadlines are those of each partner college (mostly early November for early rounds and early January for regular decision). Davis scholars also get access to a network of thousands of alumni and summer and career opportunities.

en: Need-based aid at 106 US partner colleges
Often a full ride once admitted
No separate application: just be a UWC graduate

eligibility.en: Graduates of one of the 18 UWC schools (having completed the final two years of secondary school there) who gain admission on their own merit to a Davis partner college and demonstrate financial need.

en: Check the current Davis partner list on davisuwcscholars.org
Apply to partner colleges through the Common App by their own deadlines (mostly 1–15 Jan 2027)
Submit each college's financial aid forms (CSS Profile etc.)
Admitted UWC graduates with need receive aid that includes Davis funding

costs.en: Need-based aid that meets demonstrated need (tuition, housing, food and more) at partner colleges; Davis pays grants to colleges, not to students directly.

score_reason: Huge full-need network but limited to UWC graduates; no single deadline.

name.en: MIT Need-Based Financial Aid for International Students (Fall 2027)
name.ka: MIT — საჭიროებაზე დაფუძნებული ფინანსური დახმარება საერთაშორისო სტუდენტებისთვის (2027 შემოდგომა)
name.ar: المساعدات المالية القائمة على الحاجة للطلاب الدوليين في معهد ماساتشوستس للتكنولوجيا (MIT) (خريف 2027)

deadline_note: MIT deadlines page: Regular Action due 4 Jan 2027 (Early Action 1 Nov 2026); financial aid documents for RA by 15 Feb 2027.

summary.en: MIT is need-blind and full-need for all applicants, including international students: admissions ignores ability to pay and aid meets 100% of demonstrated need. Families earning under US$200,000 attend tuition-free and under US$100,000 pay nothing.
summary.ka: MIT ყველა აპლიკანტისთვის, მათ შორის საერთაშორისოსთვის, need-blind და full-need პოლიტიკას იყენებს: მიღებისას გადახდისუნარიანობა არ ფასდება, ხოლო დახმარება დადასტურებული საჭიროების 100%-ს ფარავს. 200 000 დოლარზე ნაკლები შემოსავლის ოჯახები სწავლის საფასურს არ იხდიან, 100 000-ზე ნაკლების — არაფერს.
summary.ar: تعتمد MIT سياسة القبول دون النظر إلى القدرة المالية وتغطية الحاجة كاملة لجميع المتقدمين بمن فيهم الدوليون. الأسر التي يقل دخلها عن 200,000 دولار لا تدفع الرسوم الدراسية، ومن يقل دخلها عن 100,000 دولار لا تدفع شيئًا.

about.en:
MIT is one of very few US universities that are both need-blind and full-need for every applicant, regardless of citizenship. Admissions never considers whether you can pay, and if you are admitted MIT meets 100% of your demonstrated financial need with scholarships, not loans in the standard package.

From the 2025–26 academic year, students whose family income is under US$200,000 a year (with typical assets) attend MIT tuition-free, and families earning under US$100,000 are not expected to contribute at all, so aid also covers housing, food and other costs. The 2026–27 full cost of attendance is about US$92,760, so for many international families this is effectively a full ride.

Apply by 1 November 2026 (Early Action, non-binding) or 4 January 2027 (Regular Action) through MIT's own application portal, then submit the CSS Profile and MIT's financial aid documents (RA: by 15 February 2027). MIT requires the SAT or ACT.

en: Need-blind admission for international applicants
Tuition-free under US$200k family income; US$0 under US$100k
Aid meets 100% of demonstrated need

eligibility.en: Students of any nationality applying as first-years through MIT's own application. SAT or ACT required; English proficiency test recommended for non-native speakers. Aid is based solely on demonstrated financial need (no merit scholarships).

en: Create an account on the MIT application portal (MyMIT)
Submit the application, essays, two teacher recommendations and the school report by 4 Jan 2027 (or EA 1 Nov 2026)
Submit the CSS Profile and MIT financial aid documents by 15 Feb 2027
Receive your aid offer with your admission decision in mid-March

costs.en: Up to the full cost of attendance (≈ US$92,760 in 2026–27): tuition, housing, food, books and personal expenses, depending on family income and assets.

score_reason: Need-blind full-need aid for internationals at the world's top tech university.

name.en: Harvard College Need-Based Financial Aid for International Students (Fall 2027)
name.ka: Harvard College — საჭიროებაზე დაფუძნებული ფინანსური დახმარება საერთაშორისო სტუდენტებისთვის (2027 შემოდგომა)
name.ar: المساعدات المالية القائمة على الحاجة للطلاب الدوليين في كلية هارفارد (خريف 2027)

deadline_note: Harvard first-year page: Regular Decision 1 Jan 2027, Restrictive Early Action 1 Nov 2026; decisions end of March.

summary.en: Harvard admits international students need-blind and gives them aid on exactly the same basis as Americans. Families earning under US$100,000 pay nothing and those under US$200,000 have at least full tuition covered.
summary.ka: Harvard საერთაშორისო სტუდენტებს need-blind პრინციპით იღებს და დახმარებას ამერიკელების თანაბრად აძლევს. 100 000 დოლარზე ნაკლები შემოსავლის ოჯახები არაფერს იხდიან, 200 000-ზე ნაკლების — სულ მცირე სწავლის საფასური სრულად იფარება.
summary.ar: تقبل هارفارد الطلاب الدوليين دون النظر إلى قدرتهم المالية وتمنحهم المساعدات على قدم المساواة مع الأمريكيين. الأسر التي يقل دخلها عن 100,000 دولار لا تدفع شيئًا، ومن يقل دخلها عن 200,000 دولار تُغطّى رسومها الدراسية كاملة على الأقل.

about.en:
Harvard College's admission process is need-blind for every applicant, and its financial aid fact sheet states that foreign students have the same access to financial aid as US citizens, funded by Harvard's own scholarship money. Aid is entirely need-based; there are no merit scholarships.

From 2025–26, families with incomes below US$100,000 (and typical assets) are not expected to contribute anything, so aid covers tuition, housing, food, fees and more. For families below US$200,000, aid covers at least the full cost of tuition, and families above that can still qualify depending on circumstances.

Apply through the Common App by 1 November 2026 (Restrictive Early Action) or 1 January 2027 (Regular Decision) and submit the CSS Profile and Harvard's aid documents. You can compare offers and decide by 1 May.

en: Need-blind admission and equal aid for international students
US$0 family contribution under US$100k income
At least full tuition under US$200k income

eligibility.en: First-year applicants of any nationality. Aid depends solely on demonstrated need, assessed from the CSS Profile and supporting documents.

en: Apply via the Common App by 1 Jan 2027 (RD) or 1 Nov 2026 (REA)
Submit the CSS Profile and Harvard's financial aid documents
Receive your aid estimate with your admission decision

costs.en: Up to the full cost of attendance (tuition, housing, food, fees and allowances) depending on family income and assets; no loans required.

score_reason: Need-blind and full-need for internationals; deadline 1 Jan 2027.

name.en: Yale College Need-Based Financial Aid for International Students (Fall 2027)
name.ka: Yale College — საჭიროებაზე დაფუძნებული ფინანსური დახმარება საერთაშორისო სტუდენტებისთვის (2027 შემოდგომა)
name.ar: المساعدات المالية القائمة على الحاجة للطلاب الدوليين في كلية ييل (خريف 2027)

deadline_note: Yale timelines: Regular Decision 2 Jan 2027 (Single-Choice Early Action 1 Nov 2026); financial aid documents for internationals: SCEA 1 Dec, RD 15 Feb 2027.

summary.en: Yale is need-blind for international applicants and meets 100% of demonstrated need without loans regardless of citizenship. Families below US$100,000 pay nothing and below US$200,000 pay no tuition.
summary.ka: Yale საერთაშორისო აპლიკანტებისთვის need-blind-ია და მოქალაქეობის მიუხედავად დადასტურებული საჭიროების 100%-ს სესხების გარეშე ფარავს. 100 000 დოლარზე ნაკლები შემოსავლის ოჯახები არაფერს იხდიან, 200 000-ზე ნაკლების — სწავლის საფასურს არ იხდიან.
summary.ar: تعتمد ييل القبول دون النظر إلى القدرة المالية للمتقدمين الدوليين وتغطي 100% من الحاجة المثبتة دون قروض بغض النظر عن الجنسية. الأسر التي يقل دخلها عن 100,000 دولار لا تدفع شيئًا، ومن يقل دخلها عن 200,000 لا تدفع الرسوم الدراسية.

about.en:
Yale College awards every dollar of undergraduate aid on the basis of need, and its aid offers meet 100% of demonstrated need regardless of a student's citizenship or immigration status, using scholarships rather than loans. Admission is need-blind, so asking for aid does not affect your chances.

For new students from 2026–27, families with typical assets and incomes below US$100,000 have all expected costs eliminated, and those below US$200,000 receive scholarships that at least cover tuition. Aid for international students includes allowances for housing, meals and travel to and from campus, and Yale accounts for differences between the US economy and your home country's.

Apply by 1 November 2026 (Single-Choice Early Action) or 2 January 2027 (Regular Decision) via the Common App, Coalition or QuestBridge. International students submit the CSS Profile and Yale's aid forms (Yale does not accept the ISFAA in their place) by 1 December (SCEA) or 15 February 2027 (RD).

en: Need-blind, 100% of need met without loans for all citizenships
No cost under US$100k; no tuition under US$200k
Travel allowances for international students

eligibility.en: First-year applicants of any nationality. Aid is solely need-based; international applicants must complete Yale's required financial aid forms (the ISFAA is not accepted instead).

en: Apply by 2 Jan 2027 (RD) or 1 Nov 2026 (SCEA)
Complete the CSS Profile and Yale's financial aid forms
Submit aid documents by 15 Feb 2027 (RD) or 1 Dec 2026 (SCEA, internationals)
Receive your aid award with your admission decision

costs.en: Up to the full cost of attendance including housing, meals and two round trips a year, depending on need; no loans in the package.

score_reason: Need-blind full aid for internationals; RD 2 Jan 2027.

name.en: Princeton Need-Based Financial Aid for International Students (Fall 2027)
name.ka: Princeton — საჭიროებაზე დაფუძნებული ფინანსური დახმარება საერთაშორისო სტუდენტებისთვის (2027 შემოდგომა)
name.ar: المساعدات المالية القائمة على الحاجة للطلاب الدوليين في جامعة برينستون (خريف 2027)

deadline_note: Princeton: Regular Decision due 1 Jan 2027, Single-Choice Early Action 1 Nov 2026.

summary.en: Princeton is need-blind for international applicants and meets their full demonstrated need with grants, not loans. It offers no merit scholarships: all aid is based on need.
summary.ka: Princeton საერთაშორისო აპლიკანტებისთვის need-blind-ია და მათ სრულ დადასტურებულ საჭიროებას გრანტებით, და არა სესხებით, ფარავს. დამსახურების სტიპენდიებს არ გასცემს: ყველა დახმარება საჭიროებას ეფუძნება.
summary.ar: تعتمد برينستون القبول دون النظر إلى القدرة المالية للمتقدمين الدوليين وتغطي حاجتهم كاملة بمنح لا قروض. لا تقدم منح جدارة؛ فكل المساعدات قائمة على الحاجة.

about.en:
Princeton's admission is need-blind for all applicants, including international students, and the full need of all admitted international students is met in the same way as for students from the United States. Students who qualify receive grants that never have to be repaid; loans are not part of the standard offer.

Princeton has one of the most generous aid programmes in the world: aid covers the difference between Princeton's costs and what your family can contribute, and for many lower- and middle-income families that means tuition, housing and food are fully paid. The family contribution can vary depending on your country of residence. There are no academic or athletic merit scholarships.

Apply by 1 November 2026 (Single-Choice Early Action) or 1 January 2027 (Regular Decision) and complete the CSS Profile and Princeton's financial aid application.

en: Need-blind for international applicants
100% of need met with grants, no loans
Contribution adjusted for your country of residence

eligibility.en: First-year applicants of any nationality. All aid is need-based; complete the CSS Profile and Princeton's aid forms.

en: Apply via the Common App or QuestBridge by 1 Jan 2027 (or SCEA 1 Nov 2026)
Complete the CSS Profile and Princeton's financial aid application
Receive your aid award with your admission decision

costs.en: Grant aid covering the difference between the full cost of attendance and the expected family contribution; often full tuition, housing and food for low- and middle-income families.

score_reason: Need-blind grant-only aid for internationals; RD 1 Jan 2027.

name.en: Dartmouth Need-Based Financial Aid for International Students (Fall 2027)
name.ka: Dartmouth — საჭიროებაზე დაფუძნებული ფინანსური დახმარება საერთაშორისო სტუდენტებისთვის (2027 შემოდგომა)
name.ar: المساعدات المالية القائمة على الحاجة للطلاب الدوليين في كلية دارتموث (خريف 2027)

deadline_note: Dartmouth 'Apply' page: Regular Decision 2 Jan 2027, binding Early Decision 1 Nov 2026 (an older glossary page says 1 Jan, so submitting by 1 Jan is safest).

summary.en: Since the Class of 2026, Dartmouth has been need-blind for all international citizens and meets the demonstrated need of every admitted undergraduate, with an allowance for travel to the US.
summary.ka: 2026 წლის კურსიდან Dartmouth ყველა უცხო ქვეყნის მოქალაქისთვის need-blind-ია და ყველა ჩარიცხული ბაკალავრის დადასტურებულ საჭიროებას ფარავს, აშშ-ში მგზავრობის ხარჯის ჩათვლით.
summary.ar: منذ دفعة 2026 تعتمد دارتموث القبول دون النظر إلى القدرة المالية لجميع المواطنين الدوليين، وتغطي الحاجة المثبتة لكل طالب مقبول، مع مخصص للسفر إلى الولايات المتحدة.

about.en:
Dartmouth College, the Ivy League liberal arts college in Hanover, New Hampshire, expanded its need-blind admissions policy to all international citizens beginning with the Class of 2026. Your financial need is not part of the admission decision.

Dartmouth meets the demonstrated need of all admitted undergraduates, including those from other countries. Its aid for international students includes scholarships and an allowance for travel to the US, so admitted students from low- and middle-income families can attend at little or no cost.

Apply by 1 November 2026 (binding Early Decision) or 2 January 2027 (Regular Decision) via the Common App, and submit the CSS Profile and Dartmouth's aid documents (RD: by 1 February 2027).

en: Need-blind for international citizens
Meets 100% of demonstrated need
Travel allowance for international students

eligibility.en: First-year applicants of any nationality. Aid is need-based and requires the CSS Profile and supporting documents.

en: Apply via the Common App by 2 Jan 2027 (or ED by 1 Nov 2026)
Submit the CSS Profile and Dartmouth's financial aid documents (RD by 1 Feb 2027)
Receive your aid offer with the admission decision

costs.en: Scholarships meeting full demonstrated need, up to the full cost of attendance, plus a travel allowance.

score_reason: Need-blind full-need Ivy for internationals; early January deadline.

name.en: Amherst College Need-Based Financial Aid for International Students (Fall 2027)
name.ka: Amherst College — საჭიროებაზე დაფუძნებული ფინანსური დახმარება საერთაშორისო სტუდენტებისთვის (2027 შემოდგომა)

summary.en: Amherst College, a top US liberal arts college, is need-blind for international applicants and gives them financial aid on the same need basis as domestic students.
summary.ka: Amherst College, აშშ-ის ერთ-ერთი საუკეთესო ლიბერალური ხელოვნების კოლეჯი, საერთაშორისო აპლიკანტებისთვის need-blind-ია და მათ ადგილობრივებთან თანაბრად, საჭიროების მიხედვით, აძლევს ფინანსურ დახმარებას.
summary.ar: كلية أمهرست، من أفضل كليات الفنون الحرة في الولايات المتحدة، تقبل الطلاب الدوليين دون النظر إلى قدرتهم المالية وتمنحهم المساعدات على أساس الحاجة كالطلاب المحليين.

about.en:
Amherst College in Massachusetts is consistently ranked among the best liberal arts colleges in the US. It follows a need-blind policy for international applicants and awards financial aid to international students on the same need basis as domestic students, which lets it admit the most promising students from around the world without regard to ability to pay.

Aid is entirely need-based and meets full demonstrated need, so admitted students from low-income families can attend with tuition, housing and food covered. Classes are small and taught by faculty, and Amherst students can also take courses at the other Five College Consortium schools (including UMass Amherst, Smith and Mount Holyoke).

Apply through the Common App or QuestBridge by 5 January 2027 (Regular Decision) or the November Early Decision deadline, and submit the CSS Profile with Amherst's aid documents.

en: Need-blind admission for international students
Aid on the same need basis as US students
Small classes plus the Five College Consortium

eligibility.en: First-year applicants of any nationality; aid based on demonstrated need. Non-native English speakers submit TOEFL, IELTS Academic or another accepted English test.

en: Apply via the Common App or QuestBridge by 5 Jan 2027
Submit the CSS Profile and Amherst's financial aid documents
Receive your need-based aid offer with your admission decision

costs.en: Need-based aid up to the full cost of attendance (tuition, housing, food and allowances).

score_reason: Need-blind for internationals at a top liberal arts college; 5 Jan deadline.

name.en: Bowdoin College Need-Based Financial Aid for International Students (Fall 2027)
name.ka: Bowdoin College — საჭიროებაზე დაფუძნებული ფინანსური დახმარება საერთაშორისო სტუდენტებისთვის (2027 შემოდგომა)
name.ar: المساعدات المالية القائمة على الحاجة للطلاب الدوليين في كلية بودوين (خريف 2027)

deadline_note: Bowdoin dates page: Regular Decision and ED2 due 5 Jan 2027, ED1 15 Nov 2026; international students submit aid materials only after admission.

summary.en: Bowdoin College is need-blind for international students and meets the full calculated need of every admitted student with scholarships, not loans.
summary.ka: Bowdoin College საერთაშორისო სტუდენტებისთვის need-blind-ია და ყველა ჩარიცხული სტუდენტის სრულ გამოთვლილ საჭიროებას სტიპენდიებით, და არა სესხებით, ფარავს.
summary.ar: كلية بودوين تقبل الطلاب الدوليين دون النظر إلى قدرتهم المالية وتغطي الحاجة المحسوبة كاملة لكل طالب مقبول بمنح لا قروض.

about.en:
Bowdoin College on the coast of Maine is a highly selective liberal arts college and one of the few US colleges that is need-blind for international students. Your family's ability to pay is never a factor in admission, and if admitted Bowdoin meets your full calculated need using scholarships, with US$0 of loans in its aid packages.

A practical advantage for internationals: Bowdoin asks international applicants (except Canadians) to submit financial aid materials only if they are admitted, so you can focus on the application first. Regular Decision and Early Decision II applications are due 5 January 2027 (ED I: 15 November 2026), and regular decisions are released in mid-March.

en: Need-blind for international applicants
Full need met with US$0 loans
Aid forms only after you are admitted

eligibility.en: First-year applicants of any nationality. Aid is based on calculated need; international applicants file aid forms after admission.

en: Apply via the Common App or QuestBridge by 5 Jan 2027 (ED I: 15 Nov 2026)
If admitted, submit Bowdoin's international financial aid materials
Receive your scholarship package

costs.en: Scholarships meeting full calculated need, up to the full cost of attendance, with no loans.

score_reason: Need-blind, loan-free full need for internationals; 5 Jan deadline.

name.en: President's International Scholarship of Excellence (PISE) — York University (Fall 2027)
name.ka: პრეზიდენტის საერთაშორისო ბრწყინვალების სტიპენდია (PISE) — York University (2027 შემოდგომა)
name.ar: منحة الرئيس الدولية للتميّز (PISE) — جامعة يورك (خريف 2027)

deadline_note: York PISE guide: student scholarship application due 27 Jan 2027 (11:59 pm EST); school nomination and reference due 4 Feb 2027. Must first apply to York for Fall 2027.

summary.en: York University's top award for international first-years is worth C$180,000 over four years (C$45,000 a year). Applicants need an 80%+ average and a nomination from their high school (max two per school).
summary.ka: York University-ის უმაღლესი ჯილდო საერთაშორისო პირველკურსელებისთვის ოთხ წელიწადში 180 000 კანადურ დოლარს (წელიწადში 45 000-ს) შეადგენს. საჭიროა 80%+ საშუალო ქულა და სკოლის ნომინაცია (სკოლიდან მაქსიმუმ ორი).
summary.ar: أعلى جائزة في جامعة يورك للطلاب الدوليين الجدد تبلغ قيمتها 180,000 دولار كندي على أربع سنوات (45,000 سنويًا). يُشترط معدل 80% فأكثر وترشيح من المدرسة الثانوية (طالبان كحد أقصى لكل مدرسة).

about.en:
The President's International Scholarship of Excellence (PISE) is York University's most valuable award for international high-school students starting a bachelor's degree in Toronto. It is worth C$45,000 a year, renewable for four years (C$180,000 in total), which covers most or all of international tuition depending on the programme. PISE recipients also join a scholars' community with mentors, career support and networking with senior faculty; recent winners come from India, Pakistan, the UAE, Kenya, Mongolia, Nigeria and many other countries.

You must be a high-school student entering the first year of a York undergraduate degree in Fall 2027 with a final admission average of at least 80% (A) or equivalent, and be officially nominated by your guidance counsellor, principal or another senior school official. Each school can nominate at most two students. Selection looks at academic excellence, volunteer work, extracurricular activities and leadership. The award cannot be combined with York's automatic entrance scholarships.

First apply to York for admission, then submit the online International Scholarship Application (with your top achievements and essay) by 27 January 2027. York then emails your nominator, who must submit the nomination form and reference letter by 4 February 2027.

en: C$45,000 a year for four years (C$180,000)
Open to international high-school students of any country
School nomination required (max two per school)

eligibility.en: International high-school students entering the first year of a York undergraduate programme in Fall 2027 with a minimum 80% (A) admission average, officially nominated by their school. Must meet York's admission and English requirements.

en: Apply for admission to a York undergraduate programme for Fall 2027 and get your York reference number
Ask your counsellor or principal to nominate you
Submit the PISE scholarship application form by 27 Jan 2027
Your nominator submits the nomination and reference letter by 4 Feb 2027

costs.en: C$45,000 per year for four years (C$180,000), conditional on renewal requirements; not combinable with entrance scholarships.

score_reason: Near-full-tuition C$180k award; needs school nomination; Jan 2027 deadline.

name.en: McGill Major Entrance Scholarships (Fall 2027)
name.ka: McGill-ის ძირითადი შესვლის სტიპენდიები (2027 შემოდგომა)
name.ar: منح الالتحاق الكبرى في جامعة ماكغيل (خريف 2027)

summary.en: McGill's Major Entrance Scholarships are renewable merit awards of C$3,000–10,000 a year for international first-years (C$12,000 is reserved for Canadians). All admitted students are also considered for a one-year C$3,000 award.
summary.ka: McGill-ის ძირითადი შესვლის სტიპენდიები განახლებადი დამსახურების ჯილდოებია საერთაშორისო პირველკურსელებისთვის — წელიწადში 3 000–10 000 კანადური დოლარი (12 000 მხოლოდ კანადელებისთვისაა). ყველა ჩარიცხული ასევე განიხილება ერთწლიან 3 000-დოლარიან ჯილდოზე.
summary.ar: منح الالتحاق الكبرى في ماكغيل جوائز جدارة قابلة للتجديد للطلاب الدوليين الجدد بقيمة 3,000–10,000 دولار كندي سنويًا (منحة 12,000 للكنديين فقط). ويُنظر في جميع المقبولين أيضًا لجائزة سنة واحدة بقيمة 3,000 دولار.

about.en:
McGill University in Montreal, Canada's top-ranked university in many global tables, offers centrally administered entrance scholarships to first-time university students. Major Entrance Scholarships are worth C$3,000, C$5,000, C$10,000 or C$12,000 a year, renewable for up to four years (total C$12,000–48,000); the C$12,000 level is only for Canadian citizens and permanent residents, so international students can receive up to C$10,000 a year (C$40,000 in total).

Selection committees award them on academic achievement and outstanding leadership in school or community activities. Every applicant to an eligible programme is also automatically considered for a one-year C$3,000 entrance scholarship. Some programmes (e.g. certain professional ones) are excluded.

Applications open on 1 October in McGill's Undergraduate Admissions applicant portal. Students at schools outside Canada must apply for admission by 15 January 2027 and submit the Major Entrance Scholarship application, with two reference letters and a signed school statement if available, by 21 January 2027 (midnight Montreal time).

en: Up to C$10,000 a year for four years for internationals
Automatic C$3,000 one-year award for eligible applicants
Leadership counts alongside grades

eligibility.en: First-time university students entering a full-time McGill undergraduate programme, including international students (C$12,000 tier limited to Canadians). Must meet minimum academic requirements; selection on grades and leadership.

en: Apply for admission to McGill by 15 Jan 2027
Open the Major Entrance Scholarship application in the Applicant Portal (from 1 Oct)
Arrange two reference letters and a signed school statement (if available)
Submit everything by 21 Jan 2027, midnight Montreal time

costs.en: C$3,000–10,000 per year (renewable up to four years) for international students; international tuition at McGill is far higher, so this is partial support.

score_reason: Partial but renewable merit award at a top Canadian university; Jan 2027.

name.en: NYU Abu Dhabi Need-Based Financial Aid for International Students (Fall 2027)
name.ka: NYU Abu Dhabi — საჭიროებაზე დაფუძნებული ფინანსური დახმარება საერთაშორისო სტუდენტებისთვის (2027 შემოდგომა)
name.ar: المساعدات المالية القائمة على الحاجة في جامعة نيويورك أبوظبي للطلاب الدوليين (خريف 2027)

deadline_note: NYUAD key dates: Regular Decision 5 Jan 2027 (ED I 1 Nov 2026, ED II 1 Jan 2027); CSS Profile due 1 Feb 2027 for RD (ED I 10 Nov, ED II 10 Jan).

summary.en: NYU Abu Dhabi, NYU's degree-granting campus in the UAE, gives all non-Emirati students need-based grants calculated from the CSS Profile. Aid is renewed at the same level each year if you meet the requirements.
summary.ka: NYU Abu Dhabi, NYU-ის ხარისხის მიმნიჭებელი კამპუსი არაბთა გაერთიანებულ საამიროებში, ყველა არაემირატელ სტუდენტს აძლევს საჭიროებაზე დაფუძნებულ გრანტებს, რომლებიც CSS Profile-ით ითვლება. დახმარება ყოველწლიურად იმავე დონეზე ახლდება, თუ მოთხოვნებს აკმაყოფილებთ.
summary.ar: تمنح جامعة نيويورك أبوظبي، الحرم المانح للشهادات التابع لجامعة نيويورك في الإمارات، جميع الطلاب غير الإماراتيين منحًا قائمة على الحاجة تُحسب عبر CSS Profile. وتتجدد المساعدة بالمستوى نفسه سنويًا عند استيفاء الشروط.

about.en:
NYU Abu Dhabi is a highly selective liberal arts and sciences campus of New York University on Saadiyat Island, Abu Dhabi, where students earn an NYU degree and spend semesters at NYU's global sites. Admission is through the Common App, followed by an invitation-only Candidate Weekend.

For students who are not UAE nationals, all financial aid offered by NYUAD is based on financial need, calculated by NYU's Office of Financial Aid from the CSS Profile. Award amounts vary with each family's need and can cover a large part or all of the cost of attendance; aid is normally renewed at the same level each year if renewal requirements are met. (Emirati students receive the separate Sheikh Mohamed bin Zayed Scholarship.)

Apply by 1 November 2026 (ED I), 1 January 2027 (ED II) or 5 January 2027 (Regular Decision), and file the CSS Profile by 10 November, 10 January or 1 February respectively, before decisions are released. Missing the CSS deadline can cost you aid.

en: Need-based grants for all non-Emirati students
Aid renewed annually at the same level
NYU degree with study at NYU's global sites

eligibility.en: Applicants of any nationality applying as first-years via the Common App. Need-based aid requires the CSS Profile (and noncustodial parent Profile if applicable) by the deadline for your round.

en: Submit the Common App with the NYU Abu Dhabi application by 5 Jan 2027 (or ED I 1 Nov / ED II 1 Jan)
File the CSS Profile by 1 Feb 2027 for RD (10 Nov ED I, 10 Jan ED II)
Upload any extra documents requested by NYU's Office of Financial Aid
Attend Candidate Weekend if invited; aid offers come with admission

costs.en: Need-based grants up to the full cost of attendance (tuition, housing, meals and more), depending on family need.

score_reason: Elite US degree in the Gulf with need-based aid for all; RD 5 Jan 2027.

name.ka: AUS-ის პრეზიდენტის სტიპენდია არაბთა საამიროების გარეთ სკოლადამთავრებულთათვის (2027 შემოდგომა)
name.ar: منحة الرئيس في الجامعة الأمريكية في الشارقة للطلاب الذين أكملوا الثانوية خارج الإمارات (خريف 2027)

deadline_note: AUS Grants and Scholarships page: Fall 2027 application deadline 1 Apr 2027; you must first hold an AUS admission offer.

summary.en: The American University of Sharjah covers 100% of tuition and lab fees, plus the application fee, for top students who completed secondary school outside the UAE. It requires near-perfect grades (98% in grades 10–12) and strong test scores.
summary.ka: Sharjah-ის ამერიკული უნივერსიტეტი ფარავს სწავლისა და ლაბორატორიის საფასურის 100%-ს და განაცხადის მოსაკრებელს იმ წარჩინებული სტუდენტებისთვის, რომლებმაც სკოლა არაბთა საამიროების გარეთ დაამთავრეს. საჭიროა თითქმის იდეალური ნიშნები (98% მე-10–12 კლასებში) და მაღალი ტესტის ქულები.
summary.ar: تغطي الجامعة الأمريكية في الشارقة 100% من الرسوم الدراسية ورسوم المختبرات ورسوم الطلب للطلاب المتفوقين الذين أنهوا الثانوية خارج الإمارات. يتطلب ذلك درجات شبه كاملة (98% في الصفوف 10–12) ودرجات اختبارات قوية.

about.en:
The American University of Sharjah (AUS) is one of the leading US-style universities in the Gulf, accredited in the US and known for engineering, architecture, business and the arts. Its President's Scholarship is aimed at outstanding applicants who completed their secondary education outside the UAE, and covers 100% of tuition and lab fees plus an application-fee waiver for the length of the degree (subject to continuation conditions).

The academic bar is very high: a 98% cumulative average in grades 10 and 11 and 98% in grade 12 (or the equivalent in other systems), a high IELTS/English score, and either three AP exams at grade 5 or an SAT composite of at least 1400 (predicted APs or SAT submitted with the admission application). Students who do not qualify can still be considered for AUS merit scholarships (10–20% of tuition) and need-based grants.

You must first receive an admission offer, then apply for the scholarship through the AUS scholarship portal by 1 April 2027, so leave time for the admission process.

en: 100% of tuition and lab fees
Application-fee waiver
For applicants schooled outside the UAE

eligibility.en: Applicants of any nationality who completed secondary school outside the UAE, hold an AUS admission offer for Fall 2027, have 98% averages in grades 10–11 and grade 12 (or equivalent), meet AUS's English requirement and have three AP 5s or SAT 1400+.

en: Apply for admission to AUS for Fall 2027 (allow time for processing)
Submit SAT scores or predicted AP grades with your admission application
After receiving an offer, apply for the President's Scholarship on the AUS scholarship portal by 1 Apr 2027
Keep the required GPA to retain the scholarship

costs.en: 100% of tuition and lab fees plus application-fee waiver; housing, food and other costs are not covered.

score_reason: Full-tuition award for international (non-UAE-schooled) top students; Apr 2027.

name.en: AUS Chancellor's Scholarship for UAE-Schooled Students (Fall 2027)
name.ka: AUS-ის კანცლერის სტიპენდია არაბთა საამიროებში სკოლადამთავრებულთათვის (2027 შემოდგომა)
name.ar: منحة المستشار في الجامعة الأمريكية في الشارقة لخريجي مدارس الإمارات (خريف 2027)

deadline_note: AUS Grants and Scholarships page: Chancellor's Scholarship Fall 2027 application deadline 1 Apr 2027, after receiving an admission offer.

summary.en: For students who finish secondary school in the UAE (of any nationality), AUS's Chancellor's Scholarship covers full tuition and lab fees, on-campus housing, medical insurance and the application fee.
summary.ka: სტუდენტებისთვის, რომლებიც სკოლას არაბთა საამიროებში ამთავრებენ (ნებისმიერი მოქალაქეობით), AUS-ის კანცლერის სტიპენდია ფარავს სწავლისა და ლაბორატორიის სრულ საფასურს, კამპუსის საცხოვრებელს, სამედიცინო დაზღვევასა და განაცხადის მოსაკრებელს.
summary.ar: للطلاب الذين يُنهون الثانوية في الإمارات (من أي جنسية)، تغطي منحة المستشار في الجامعة الأمريكية في الشارقة الرسوم الدراسية ورسوم المختبرات كاملة والسكن الجامعي والتأمين الطبي ورسوم الطلب.

about.en:
The Chancellor's Scholarship is the American University of Sharjah's most comprehensive award, open to applicants who completed their secondary education in the UAE, including expatriate students of any nationality. It covers full tuition and lab fees, an application-fee waiver, on-campus housing and student medical insurance.

Applicants need a 98% cumulative average in grades 10 and 11 plus 98% in grade 12 (or the equivalent: for example, the National Curriculum Elite Stream, or ATAR 96+ for Australian qualifications), AUS's English requirement, and two AP exams at grade 5 or an SAT composite of 1200+. The scholarship file also asks for evidence of leadership and contributions (honours, community service, extracurriculars), a three-minute video explaining why you should be selected and two letters of recommendation.

You must first be admitted to AUS, then submit the scholarship application through the AUS portal by 1 April 2027.

en: Full tuition and lab fees plus on-campus housing
Medical insurance and application-fee waiver
Open to any nationality schooled in the UAE

about.en:
The United Arab Emirates University in Al Ain is the country's first and largest federal university. Since 2025/2026 it has offered tuition discounts to international students under the Chancellor's Scholarship for Elite Students. The top level gives a 100% tuition waiver to applicants with at least 98% in grade 12 (or equivalent), TOEFL iBT 105 / IELTS 7.5, and (for most colleges) SAT Math 730 or ACT Math 32. A second level gives a 75% waiver for 95%+, TOEFL 85 / IELTS 6.5 and SAT Math 660 / ACT Math 28. There is also a Chancellor's Scholarship for Talented Students (innovation, arts, sport, technology).

The waiver covers tuition only (not housing or application fees) and continues until graduation if you keep a GPA of at least 3.8 (100% level) or 3.6 (75% level), take 15+ credits per semester and hold no other scholarship. Meeting the criteria does not guarantee an award; seats are limited.

There is no separate form: you apply for the scholarship as part of the UAEU admission application during the announced undergraduate admission periods for international students.

Renewable to graduation with a high GPA
Requested inside the admission application

about.en:
The Global Korea Scholarship for Undergraduate Degrees (GKS-U), run by Korea's National Institute for International Education (NIIED), is one of Asia's most complete government scholarships. Scholars first take a one-year Korean language programme, then a 4–6 year bachelor's degree at a Korean university. NIIED pays up to KRW 5 million of tuition per semester (the university waives the rest and the admission fee), the language programme fee, an economy return flight, and a monthly allowance of KRW 1,200,000 during the degree (KRW 1,130,000 during language study) covering living costs, housing and health insurance.

For 2027 the Embassy Track closed on 30 September 2026, but the University Track still runs through November 2026. Its UIC (University-Industry Cooperation) programme offers 100 places at 13 institutions, is open to applicants from every country, and combines the degree with industry-oriented curriculum and field experience. Embassy-track applicants who failed round one can also apply here.

Important eligibility point: you must be under 25 (born on or after 1 March 2002) and have graduated from high school, or be expected to graduate, by 31 December 2026, with an 80%+ average or a top-20% class rank. Students finishing school in mid-2027 must wait for the GKS-U 2028 call (expected September 2027).

about.en:
Nagoya University is one of Japan's leading national research universities. Through its Global 30 (G30) International Programs it offers fully English-taught bachelor's degrees, starting in October, including Automotive Engineering, Civil and Environmental Engineering, Physics, Chemistry, Biological Science, Earth and Environmental Sciences, Biological and Bioagricultural Sciences, Economics and Business Administration, Law and Political Science, and Japan-in-Asia Cultural Studies.

According to the G30 site, roughly 10–15% of students receive a full scholarship covering tuition and offering a small to moderate stipend, awarded after a holistic review of academic merit, extracurricular engagement and financial need. Admitted students in need can also get registration and tuition fee waivers of 50–100%, and self-financed students may receive the government's Monbukagakusho Honors Scholarship (JPY 48,000/month for six months). The Japanese Government (MEXT) Embassy Recommendation scholarship (JPY 117,000/month) is a separate route with embassy applications in spring.

The 2027 first-round application window is 2–19 November 2026; a second round for a limited set of programmes runs 5–21 January 2027.

about.en:
HKUST is one of Asia's leading universities for science, engineering and business (6th in the QS Asia University Rankings 2026 and 33rd in the QS World University Rankings 2027, as HKUST reports). All applicants are automatically considered for academic admission scholarships, with no separate application. For holders of international qualifications such as IB, A-levels, AP/SAT or national diplomas, awards may be one-off or renewable and may fully or partially waive tuition; the largest is full tuition plus an allowance of HK$65,000 per year, renewable for the normal length of study.

The Global Learners Scholarship, created to diversify the student body, automatically considers all applicants from under-represented nationalities and gives successful awardees a full tuition waiver for the normal duration of study. Separate applications are needed for non-academic awards such as the Beyond Academic Admissions Scholarship and the new Future Leaders Award.

Applications for 2027/28 are open now. Apply by the Priority Round deadline of 25 November 2026 for the best chance; applications are accepted on a rolling basis afterwards until 30 June 2027. Scholarship decisions normally arrive with the admission offer.

Full tuition waiver for under-represented nationalities
Automatic consideration; priority deadline 25 Nov 2026

eligibility.en: Applicants to HKUST undergraduate programmes with international or other non-local qualifications, of any nationality. Selection is holistic on academic merit; Global Learners targets nationalities under-represented at HKUST.

Apply separately for non-academic awards (BAAS, Future Leaders Award) if relevant

costs.en: Ranges from partial tuition waivers to full tuition plus HK$65,000 per year; Global Learners: full tuition waiver.

about.en:
Duke Kunshan University (DKU), near Shanghai, is a joint venture of Duke University, Wuhan University and the city of Kunshan. Undergraduates earn both a Duke University degree and a DKU degree through an interdisciplinary liberal arts curriculum taught in English, with opportunities to study at Duke in North Carolina.

International applicants can receive both need-based financial aid and merit scholarships that typically cover up to, and including, full tuition; more than 80% of international students received financial aid and/or scholarships last year, and awards are renewed annually for four years if requirements are met. For the Class of 2031, full cost-of-attendance Global Leaders Full Scholarship Awards are available for a very select few international students (extra application required). DKU is need-aware, so request aid only if you need it, but note that students who do not apply for aid at the admission stage cannot apply later.

Apply via the Common App (no application fee) by 2 November 2026 (Early Decision) or 4 January 2027 (Regular Decision), and submit the CSS Profile (DKU code 7059) if seeking need-based aid.

en: Duke University degree earned in China
Aid and merit typically up to full tuition; 80%+ of internationals funded
No application fee

eligibility.en: International (non-Chinese-citizen) first-year applicants via the Common App. Need-based aid requires the CSS Profile; Global Leaders Full Scholarship requires an additional application by the admission deadline.

Answer 'yes' to financial aid and submit the CSS Profile (code 7059) if you need aid
If eligible, submit the separate Global Leaders Full Scholarship application
Receive scholarship/aid decisions with your admission offer

about.en:
The University of Sydney, Australia's oldest university and a member of the Group of Eight, offers the Sydney International Undergraduate Academic Excellence Scholarship to high-achieving international school leavers. It covers 100% of tuition fees and the Student Services and Amenities Fee (SSAF) for the published full-time duration of a single undergraduate degree (up to four years, including embedded honours).

About 20 scholarships are awarded globally each year across the February and July intakes, with a focus on diversity of course and nationality. Applications for Semester 1 2027 have closed, but applications are welcome for students commencing in Semester 2 (July) 2027. You must have applied for (but not started) an eligible single undergraduate degree, have finished secondary school or an approved foundation programme, and have no previous tertiary study.

Recipients pay their own living costs, accommodation, Overseas Student Health Cover, textbooks and flights. Only successful applicants are contacted.

en: 100% tuition + SSAF for the whole degree
About 20 awards a year worldwide
Open now for July 2027 entry

eligibility.en: International students (not Australian citizens/PRs or dual Australians) who have completed secondary school or an approved foundation programme, have applied for an eligible single undergraduate degree of up to four years starting Semester 2 2027, and have not undertaken tertiary study.

en: Apply to the University of Sydney for an eligible bachelor's degree starting Semester 2, 2027
Submit the scholarship application through the scholarship page while it is open
Wait to be contacted (only successful applicants are notified)
Enrol full-time to activate the award

costs.en: 100% of tuition fees and SSAF for the standard full-time duration; living costs, accommodation, OSHC, books and flights not covered.

score_reason: Full tuition for the whole degree; very competitive; open for July 2027.

about.en:
The Vice-Chancellor's International Scholarships Scheme (VCIS) supports high-achieving international students starting a coursework degree (including bachelor's degrees) at the University of Sydney. It is paid once, in the first year: depending on your ranking you can receive A$60,000 or A$40,000 (paid over two semesters), or A$20,000, A$10,000 or A$5,000 (paid for one semester). It is not renewable.

No application is needed: every eligible student who holds an unconditional offer of admission by a round's closing date is automatically considered, subject to funding. For Semester 1 (February) 2027 the last regular round closes on 16 November 2026, with extra offer rounds for IB graduates after the December results and for international UAC students after the 23 December offer round. For Semester 2 (July) 2027 the rounds close on 15 February, 22 March and 3 May 2027.

Automatic with an unconditional offer
Several rounds through May 2027

en: Apply to the University of Sydney and secure an unconditional offer before a round closes
No scholarship form needed: eligible students are considered automatically
Successful students are told the award amount (A$5,000–60,000)

costs.en: One-off first-year award of A$60,000, A$40,000, A$20,000, A$10,000 or A$5,000; not renewable.

score_reason: Automatic but first-year-only partial award.

summary.ka: Kyoto iUP ყოველწლიურად 40 საერთაშორისო სტუდენტს იღებს Kyoto University-ის პროგრამებზე ექვსთვიანი იაპონური ენის მოსამზადებელი კურსით. ყველა iUP სტუდენტი სრულად თავისუფლდება მიღების მოსაკრებლისგან, იღებს სწავლის საფასურის სრულ ან ნაწილობრივ შეღავათს 4,5 წლით და მოსამზადებელ კურსზე თვეში 120 000 იენამდე.

about.en:
Kyoto University, one of Asia's most prestigious research universities, runs the Kyoto International Undergraduate Program (Kyoto iUP) to bring talented international students into its regular faculties. Students start with a six-month preparatory course (intensive Japanese and academic preparation) and then complete a four-year bachelor's degree in one of nine faculties: Integrated Human Studies, Letters, Education, Law, Economics, Science, Pharmaceutical Sciences, Engineering or Agriculture.

Funding is built in: every Kyoto iUP student receives a full admission-fee waiver and full or partial tuition waivers for four and a half years, plus a monthly allowance of up to JPY 120,000 during the preparatory course. After entering the undergraduate course, merit-based monthly allowances from supporting companies and organisations are available to eligible students.

There are 40 places for October 2027 enrolment. Applications are made through the online system between 2 November and 3 December 2026 (5 pm Japan time).

Up to JPY 120,000/month during the 6-month prep course
40 places in nine Kyoto University faculties

about.en:
The Gwangju Institute of Science and Technology (GIST) is a research-intensive science and engineering institute in southwest Korea, with a small undergraduate college (GIST College) focused on the natural sciences and engineering.

International undergraduates receive a full tuition waiver for eight semesters with no conditions, a settlement subsidy of KRW 200,000 and reimbursement of a one-way flight after their first month. Monthly support includes a student allowance of KRW 130,000 and a meal allowance of KRW 270,000 (for students with at least 11 credits and no probation), plus an international allowance of KRW 130,000 for students who keep a good GPA.

The 2027 application period runs from 1 December 2026 to 29 January 2027 (Korea time) on GIST's online admission system.

Monthly allowances (~KRW 400,000–530,000) plus settlement grant
STEM degree at a Korean research institute

about.en:
POSTECH in Pohang is a small, research-intensive science and technology university, one of Korea's leading institutions for science and engineering. International undergraduates are admitted twice a year through the International Admissions track (no interview required) and study alongside Korean students.

According to POSTECH's international admissions office, every admitted Korean and international undergraduate receives a full tuition waiver in the first semester; it continues for up to eight semesters for students who keep a GPA of at least 3.0/4.3. International students also receive a living allowance of KRW 500,000 per month (including vacations, no GPA requirement), an Arrival Scholarship reimbursing a one-way economy flight and domestic travel (up to KRW 2.5 million), a KRW 300,000 bonus for reaching TOPIK level 4, and from the fourth semester a Pathfinder learning voucher worth KRW 2.5 million a year. Scholarships are considered automatically during admission.

The Spring 2027 round has closed. The Fall 2027 intake is expected to open for applications from late March to early April 2027, with guidelines published in late January or early February 2027 and results in late June.

KRW 500,000/month living allowance for internationals
Flight to Korea reimbursed; no interview required

about.en:
Peking University (PKU) in Beijing is one of China's two most prestigious universities. In 2012 it created the Peking University International Student Scholarship to attract outstanding international students to its bachelor's, master's and doctoral programmes. For undergraduates it lasts four years and covers a tuition waiver, a living allowance and medical insurance, subject to passing an annual scholarship review.

Applicants must meet PKU's international admission requirements, have submitted an application to a full-time self-funded PKU degree programme, and hold no other scholarship. According to PKU's International Students Office, new bachelor's applicants do not need to submit a separate scholarship application: the university awards the scholarship on merit based on the final admission results. PKU admits international undergraduates through several routes, including an entrance examination, an exam-free route using recognised international test results, the Boya overseas talent programme and the Guanghua Future Leaders programme.

Scholarship applications at PKU generally take place between January and March each year; check the 2027 undergraduate admission brochure on the PKU International Students Office website as soon as it is published.

about.en:
The American University in Dubai (AUD) is a private American-style university in Dubai Media City offering a range of English-taught bachelor's degrees, including communication through its Mohammed Bin Rashid School for Communication. Since 1999 it has offered scholarships bearing the name of H.H. Sheikh Mohammed Bin Rashid Al Maktoum, created to reward academic excellence and respond to financial need.

The scholarship is open to all nationalities and all undergraduate programmes. High-school applicants need at least a 90% average (or equivalent), and financial need (insufficient means to fund the degree) is also considered. Depending on the Scholarship Committee's decision, it gives a partial or full tuition waiver, granted for the first year and maintained until graduation as long as the conditions are met.

Awards are made for fall entry only and applications are submitted through AUD's dedicated scholarship portal; apply together with your Fall 2027 admission application.

about.en:
The Freeman Asian Scholarship Program, created in 1995 with the Freeman Foundation and now funded by Wesleyan itself, brings exceptionally promising Asian students to Wesleyan University in Connecticut, a leading US liberal arts university. Each Freeman Scholar receives a scholarship covering the full cost of attendance for four years: tuition, fees, room and board, supplies, and travel to and from the home country, worth over US$100,000.

Citizens and permanent residents of China, Hong Kong, Indonesia, Japan, Malaysia, the Philippines, Singapore, South Korea, Taiwan, Thailand and Vietnam who apply to Wesleyan as financial-aid-seeking candidates are considered automatically. Around 11 students are chosen each year, so it is extremely competitive: selection looks at academic achievement, intellectual curiosity, discipline, personal qualities, community involvement, leadership and English ability. Interviews are not part of selection (optional InitialView interviews are accepted), and Wesleyan is test-optional but encourages SAT/ACT from non-exam-based curricula.

Apply through the Common App by 1 January 2027 (Regular Decision, when most Freeman offers are made) or by an Early Decision deadline, with Wesleyan's international financial aid documents.
